input.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, urllib.error, ssl, time
endpoints=[
 'http://localhost:47301/checkConnectivity?variant=1',
 'https://httpstat.us/200'
]
for url in endpoints:
    print('URL:',url)
    t=time.time()
    try:
        req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'health-check/1.0'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
            body=r.read(500)
            elapsed=time.time()-t
            print('STATUS:', r.status, r.reason)
            print('ELAPSED_MS:', int(elapsed*1000))
            print('HEADERS:', dict(r.headers))
            try:
                text=body.decode('utf-8','replace')
            except Exception:
                text=repr(body)
            print('BODY_PREVIEW:', text[:500])
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        elapsed=time.time()-t
        body=e.read(500)
        print('STATUS:', e.code, e.reason)
        print('ELAPSED_MS:', int(elapsed*1000))
        print('HEADERS:', dict(e.headers))
        print('BODY_PREVIEW:', body.decode('utf-8','replace')[:500])
    except Exception as e:
        elapsed=time.time()-t
        print('ERROR:', type(e).__name__, str(e))
        print('ELAPSED_MS:', int(elapsed*1000))
    print('---')
PY
